summary: plan.md is written; I didn't build or render anything, so it is untested. The form: a plain off-white (smooth quartz) loft block, x 1..23, z 1..42, up to y 38, with a strict grid of 3-wide recessed windows between 1-wide piers, 11 floors under a flat cornice, plus a low 2-storey wing on Washington St. One change from your brief: following the lidar, the tower is 13x13 (x 1..13, z 17..29, up to y 61), not 9x9; corner piers frame a 9-wide set-back panel so it still reads slim. It carries four 7-wide glowing clocks with green copper rims, a cornice, and a grey metal pyramid cut flat for a glass lantern on top. Pale smooth_quartz 15-storey loft block with a 3-wide window grid, quartz trim and polished_andesite plinth. A 13x13 tower carries four 7-wide backlit clock faces, a cornice, a truncated deepslate pyramid and a glass lantern topped by a lightning rod. A low east wing, two entrances, lamps and trees complete it.
